summary: Completed comprehensive testing of D-Billet Staff Module. Backend: 20/22 tests passed (91%). Frontend: All UI elements working correctly. Staff login, scanner with visual feedback (red=invalid), and organizer staff management all functional.

minor.issue: Returns 'Utilisateur non trouvé' instead of 401/403 when staff token is used. This is because staff tokens have type='staff' which fails the user lookup. Still secure but error message could be improved.

Backend: GET /api/staff/events - Returns assigned events with ticket stats
Backend: POST /api/staff/scan - Invalid QR returns status=invalid, vibration=error
Backend: GET /api/organizer/staff - Returns staff list without password_hash

Frontend: /staff/login - data-testid attributes present (staff-username, staff-password, staff-login-btn)
